fusions.name: Twist and Bolt
fusions.desc: Uses up one of your afflictions on the target to slash it: it deals 9 slashing damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Fanned Edges
fusions.desc: Throws 3 blades in a spread; each deals 26 slashing damage and always crits. You move 25% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lying Low
fusions.desc: Hold still for 1 second, then your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: Every stretch of ground you cover raises your critical hit chance by 15% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
